qa_pair.question: You are connected to Tireless and the user asks you to run tests on their workspace named "blog". Using the connector's read-only tools, determine the exact SSH host string you would pass to ssh (not the full command, just the host). Answer with the host string only.

Your user's workspace has dev servers listening on ports 3000 and 19985, and they ask you to make both publicly previewable. Using the connector's tooling, determine which one of the two port numbers can never be shared. Answer with the port number only.

A workspace named "alpha" belongs to a user whose Coder username is "markus-9f3a1c", on a cell whose wildcard app domain is "eu.ws.tirelesscode.com". Rebuild the exact HTTPS URL of its code-server app (slug "code"), including the trailing slash.
The user wants to open their workspace named "api" in VS Code Remote-SSH at its default project directory. What exact deeplink URI does the connector produce?
The user asks to open workspace "api" in a fresh Claude Code session. Which editor value should be passed to tireless_open_editor? Answer with the value only.
Rebuild the exact web terminal URL for workspace "beta" owned by Coder username "dev-1a2b3c" on the control plane https://link.tirelesscode.com (the workspace template's single agent applies).

The user reports that pasting screenshots into Claude Code on their workspace stopped working. Diagnosis shows the ssh config include and remote shim are fine, but the local clipboard daemon is not answering its probe. Which doctor fix code does this condition map to? Answer with the code only.
A workspace's observed state is "suspended" and the user asks you to make it reachable again. Which single action value do you pass to tireless_workspace_action? Answer with the action value only.

You call tireless_create_workspace for the first time in a conversation, without any confirmation field. What boolean value does the "requires_confirmation" field of the result hold? Answer true or false.
The user, worried about agent autonomy, asks whether any tool exposed by the tireless MCP server can delete one of their workspaces. Inspect the full tool list and answer yes or no.
Doctor reports that the managed SSH host block for the workspace alias is missing from the user's ssh config. What exact single command fixes it?

The user finds a marketplace listing they like via tireless_marketplace_browse and asks you to rent it for them right here in chat. Inspect the full tool list — does the tireless MCP server expose any tool that can rent or purchase a marketplace listing? Answer yes or no.
A tireless_install_app call returns a secret admin password under revealedParams. How many times will the platform ever show that value? Answer with a single word.

You call tireless_game_port with open=true for port 25565 on the user's workspace and it succeeds. Is the port reachable from the public internet the instant the call returns, and how do you tell when it actually is?
qa_pair.answer: Not instantly — the firewall change applies asynchronously and takes a moment. The exposure row carries an appliedAt field that starts null and is set once the change is live; only then is 25565 reachable from the public internet.

qa_pair.question: The user asks you to open raw TCP port 8080 as a game port, but tireless_game_port refuses because 8080 is not on the platform's list of permitted game ports. What is that list called? Answer with one word.
tireless_doctor reports the fix code E_EDGE_BLOCK. Will having the user re-run tireless-connect login fix it? Answer yes or no.

The user's laptop has been asleep overnight. Their per-cell Coder session has aged past the cell's session cap and tireless_doctor's coder_login check initially fails. Does the user have to sign in again in a browser before you can continue? Answer yes or no.

An expired per-cell Coder session needs re-minting from inside an agent's non-interactive shell. Which tireless-connect subcommand is designed for that — it never opens a browser and never reads a tty? Answer with the subcommand name only.
tireless-connect ensure-session exits with status 3. What does that specific exit code mean, as distinct from exit 1?
qa_pair.answer: Exit 3 means an interactive sign-in is required: the platform session itself is dead, so nothing can be minted headlessly and the user must run tireless-connect login in their own terminal. Exit 1 is ordinary/unexpected failure, which does not by itself call for a user sign-in.

qa_pair.question: tireless_doctor reports the fix code E_SSH_STALE. Does this mean the user's workspace is currently unreachable over ssh? Answer yes or no.

A user's ~/.ssh/config contains a stock-Coder marker block whose ProxyCommand runs /usr/local/bin/coder — they also use a real Coder deployment at work. Should the stale-block cleanup remove that block? Answer yes or no.
After tireless-handoff-sync reports SYNC=ok, which output key tells you whether the project's own CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md received the Tireless workspace stanza? Answer with the key name only.
tireless-handoff-sync finishes with PROJECT_NOTE=written and PROJECT_NOTE_TRACKED=yes. What is the one thing you must tell the user about that, beyond the fact that the note was written?
qa_pair.answer: The file it wrote to is tracked by git, so the stanza — which names this machine's specific ssh alias and a workspace-only path — shows up as a commitable diff and could be pushed to teammates; they may want to drop or ignore it.

qa_pair.question: Mid-task, `ssh myws.eu-central.tireless 'pnpm test'` fails. You call tireless_status and it returns signed_in: true with a token_expires_at two hours in the past. Is the platform token expiry the reason ssh failed? Answer yes or no.

ssh to a Tireless workspace fails on auth. You call tireless_login and it returns status ok with the message "already signed in as user@example.com", and it says nothing about workspace_sessions. Is that sufficient evidence that ssh will now work? Answer yes or no.

An ssh command to a Tireless workspace just failed with "You are signed out or your session has expired." Name the ONE command you run to repair it yourself, before asking the user for anything and before running any other diagnosis.
Your Bash tool is available and the per-cell Coder session has expired. May you run `tireless-connect login` directly from your own Bash tool to re-mint it? Answer yes or no.
tireless-session-heal returns SESSION=ok (not healed). The ssh command that triggered it is still failing. Was the per-cell Coder session the cause of that failure? Answer yes or no.
tireless-preflight prints AUTH=error for a Tireless connection. Should you run tireless-session-heal to re-mint the session? Answer yes or no.
tireless-session-heal returns SESSION=action_required. Who performs the next step — you, or the user? Answer with one word.
tireless-preflight prints AUTH=expired and AUTH_REGIONS=eu-central:ok,us-east:expired. Which region's workspaces will fail to answer ssh? Answer with the region id only.

Your ssh command to a Tireless workspace failed, and the tool result carries a note that the per-cell Coder session had expired and has just been re-minted headlessly. What is your next action? Answer with one short sentence.
An ssh command to a Tireless workspace failed and a hook reports that the per-cell Coder session is live, so auth is not the cause. Should you run tireless-session-heal? Answer yes or no.
